title: 第14章 阳顶天的选择

content_zh:
“可是，您的女儿非常厌恨我。”阳顶天道。
“总比无视好。”西门无涯道：“恨和爱，只有一段很短的距离，我相信只要你用心，是可以收获她的心的。焰焰眼高于项，却也简单直接，你那么聪明应该完全知道怎么对付这样的女孩。”
想起西门焰焰如火一般的充满野性，绝美精致的容颜，爱憎分明的性格，刁蛮却不乏聪明。这样的尤物，全天下的男人都会动心。
但是，阳顶天已经答应过师父东方涅灭了。师父为他付出了所有包括生命，他已经答应了，所以这是沉甸甸的责任。
“我知道，你去阴阳宗或许有很大的使命，尽管阴阳宗位列天下三宗，武道圣地强盛无比。但是阴阳宗能给你的，我云霄城未必不能给你。”西门无涯淡淡道，言语中充满了自傲。
阳顶天觉得有些口干，咽了咽喉咙道：“男女之间要互补，异性相吸，同性相斥。我是阳性玄脉，您女儿是艳火之躯，我们完全是同属性相斥啊。”
“胡说。”西门无涯笑道：“我是纯阳之躯，焰焰的母亲暴烈如火，我们不照样很恩爱。”
“你看我现在是不是非常温和？”西门无涯道。
阳顶天点了点头，道：“您完全是温润如水。”
“但我是真正的阳烈之躯，年轻的时候也完全是火爆性子，和焰焰母亲虽然互相爱得不得了，但三天两头打架，我岳父只是乐呵呵的不管。床头打架床尾和，夫妻间不打架有什么意思。”西门无涯道：“我现在性子温和了，一半是被焰焰母亲磨练出来的，一般是自己的修炼，从阳火修炼到了寒冷的阴火，性格变得冷清漠然，再到阴阳相济，性格自然变得温和包容。”
阳顶天再次惊愕了，从西门无涯简单的言语中他可以知道，眼前的西门无涯非常强大，甚至比他想象中还要强大。东方涅灭曾经说过，阳火修炼到一定程度，就会变成蓝色的阴火，到极致强大的时候，就会阴阳交融。
而且，东方涅灭给阳顶天定下的目标是十几年内，修炼出蓝色阴火，召唤出火焰指环。
而眼前的西门无涯，已经到了阴阳交融的地步了，真的完全强大到让人高山仰止。
“西门城主，您的提议非常让我动心，您的厚爱让我非常感动，您的女儿非常让人心动。”阳顶天道：“但是，很抱歉我不能答应！”
“因为某些特殊的原因，我不能答应您。”阳顶天再次道。
说完，阳顶天几乎无法直视西门无涯的充满真挚的眼睛，但依旧用力地直视。
西门无涯就这么望着阳顶天，良久后轻轻叹息一声，充满了无限的惋惜，然后缓缓闭上了双眼。
阳顶天忽然鬼使神差道：“那您是不是要杀我了？”
“为什么这么说？”西门无涯闭着眼睛道。
“书中遇到这种情形一般都会写着男主角不同意对方的招揽，对方为了不让未来多一个强大的敌人，就会将主角消灭于萌芽之中，很多强者都有这种心态，不收为己用便将其毁灭。”阳顶天道。

西门无涯扑哧一笑，一拍阳顶天脑门道：“瞎说，你都看什么乱七八糟的书。”
“我为什么会杀你？你是个好孩子，而且就算你进了阴阳宗，我们也未必会成为敌人。云霄城和阴阳宗虽然是属于对立关系，阴阳宗视我们为叛徒，但是我们之间的关系远远比你想象中要复杂得多。”西门无涯揉了揉阳顶天的脑袋道：“现在跟你说这么多你也不懂，等你进了阴阳宗就明白了。”
“好了，马上就要到东方云州阴阳宗了，我会派一艘小船送你上岸，让别人你和我在一起，对你在阴阳宗的前途不利。”西门无涯笑道，然后离开了阳顶天的舱房。
走到门口，西门无涯忽然转身道：“孩子，我的提议会一直有效，在焰焰出嫁之前。”
“还有，你叫什么名字？”西门无涯问道。
受了人家恩惠那么重，对方对你这么好，半个月了阳顶天都没有告诉西门无涯自己的名字，真是太不礼貌了，可是西门无涯没有问，阳顶天也就没有说。
“我叫阳顶天。”
西门无涯微微一愕，然后朝阳顶天露出一个微微有些促狭的表情，稍瞬即逝，笑道：“好名字，很霸道。”

content_en:
"But, your daughter hates me very much." Yang Dingtian said.
"It's better than ignoring it." Ximen Wuya said: "There is only a short distance between hate and love. I believe that as long as you work hard, you can win her heart. Yan Yanyan is higher than Xiang, but it is also simple and direct. You are so smart and you should know how to deal with such a girl."
I think of Ximen Yanyan, who is as wild as fire, with a beautiful and delicate face, a character with a clear distinction between love and hate, and is unruly but clever. Men all over the world would be attracted to such a beauty.
However, Yang Dingtian has promised Master Dongfang Nirvana. Master gave everything for him, including his life, and he has already agreed, so this is a heavy responsibility.
"I know that you may have a great mission in going to the Yin-Yang Sect. Although the Yin-Yang Sect ranks among the three sects in the world and the martial arts holy land is extremely powerful. But what the Yin-Yang Sect can give you, I, Yunxiao City, may not be able to give you." Ximen Wuya said lightly, his words full of pride.
Yang Dingtian felt his mouth was a little dry, so he swallowed and said: "Men and women should complement each other, opposite sexes attract each other, and same sexes repel each other. I am a yang profound vein, and your daughter is a body of gorgeous fire. We have completely the same attributes and repel each other."
"Nonsense." Ximen Wuya laughed and said, "I am a pure Yang body, and Yanyan's mother is as violent as fire. We are still very loving."
"Do you think I'm very gentle now?" Ximen Wuya said.
Yang Dingtian nodded and said, "You are as gentle as water."
"But I am a real yang body, and I was completely fiery when I was young. Although I and Yanyan's mother loved each other very much, they would fight every three days, and my father-in-law just happily ignored it. Fighting at the head of the bed and at the end of the bed, what's the point of not fighting between husband and wife. "Ximen Wuya said: "I have a gentle temper now, which was partly tempered by Yanyan's mother, usually through my own cultivation. From Yang Fire cultivation to cold Yin Fire, my personality became cold and indifferent, and then to the combination of Yin and Yang, my personality naturally became gentle and tolerant."
Yang Dingtian was shocked again. From Ximen Wuya's simple words, he could tell that the Ximen Wuya in front of him was very powerful, even more powerful than he imagined. Dongfang Nirvana once said that when Yang Fire is cultivated to a certain level, it will turn into blue Yin Fire. When it becomes extremely powerful, Yin and Yang will merge.
Moreover, the goal set by Dongfang Nirvana for Yang Dingtian is to cultivate blue Yin Fire and summon a flame ring within ten years.
And the Ximen Wuya in front of him has reached the point where yin and yang blend together, and he is truly so powerful that it makes people admire him.
"Lord Ximen, your proposal is very tempting to me, your love is very touching to me, and your daughter is very touching." Yang Dingtian said: "But, I'm sorry that I can't agree!"
"For some special reasons, I can't promise you." Yang Dingtian said again.
After saying that, Yang Dingtian could hardly look directly into Ximen Wuya's sincere eyes, but he still looked hard.
Ximen Wuya just stared at Yang Dingtian. After a long time, he sighed softly, full of infinite regret, and then slowly closed his eyes.
Yang Dingtian suddenly asked, "Are you going to kill me?"
"Why do you say that?" Ximen Wuya said with his eyes closed.
"When encountering this kind of situation in books, it is usually written that the male protagonist does not agree to the other party's solicitation. In order to prevent another powerful enemy in the future, the other party will nip the protagonist in the bud. Many strong people have this mentality. If they do not use it for their own purposes, they will destroy it." Yang Dingtian said.
Ximen Wuya chuckled, slapped Yang Dingtian on the forehead and said, "Nonsense, what nonsense are you reading?"
"Why would I kill you? You are a good boy, and even if you join the Yin Yang Sect, we may not become enemies. Although Yunxiao City and the Yin Yang Sect are in an antagonistic relationship, and the Yin Yang Sect regards us as traitors, the relationship between us is far more complicated than you think.Ximen Wuya rubbed Yang Dingtian's head and said, "You don't understand even if I tell you so much now. You will understand when you enter the Yin Yang Sect." "
"Okay, we are about to arrive at the Yin Yang Sect in Dongfang Yunzhou. I will send a small boat to take you ashore. Letting others stay with me will be detrimental to your future in the Yin Yang Sect. "Ximen Wuya smiled, and then left Yang Dingtian's cabin.
Walking to the door, Ximen Wuya suddenly turned around and said: "My child, my proposal will always be valid until Yanyan gets married. "
"Also, what's your name? Ximen Wuya asked.
After receiving so much favor from someone and being so kind to you, Yang Dingtian didn't tell Ximen Wuya his name for half a month. It was really rude. However, Ximen Wuya didn't ask, and Yang Dingtian didn't say it either.
"My name is Yang Dingtian. "
Ximen Wuya was slightly startled, then he showed a slightly narrowed expression towards the sky, and then he smiled and said: "What a good name, very domineering. "
